qualification: Local macOS arm64, account-free isolated server and real shipped language SDKs
behavior: The control helper returns an input-ID-correlated configuration or unauthorized error for startup rejection, and repeated calls preserve that classification.

Both Python and TypeScript use only the intended Native grant. Missing configuration, corrupt grant, elapsed authority on an actively used peer and reconnect with that elapsed grant are rejected without owner fallback.
Rust retains the verified UCTP auth.session expiry and rejects expired sessions before dispatch. It never reclassifies a timeout or transport failure after dispatch by inspecting the later clock.
Helper and JSON CLI share exhaustive typed failure mapping; protocol and application errors retain their classes. Credentials stay fixed until an explicit new client is created.
Existing grant replay/export/language parity, bounded wait, cancellation, deadline recovery and stable mutation identity checks pass. The observer sees no messages from the negative helper cases.
